# <type>(<scope>): <emoji> <subject starting lowercase, no em dash>
#
# Why the change was needed, wrapped at 72 characters. On a squash merge the
# pull request title becomes the commit that lands, so the title says what
# lands and this body says why.
#
# Types: feat fix docs style refactor perf test build ci chore revert security
# Scope: the area changed, such as workflows, scripts, docs, deps or readme
#
# Commit with `git commit -s`: the DCO check requires a Signed-off-by trailer.
# The rules: https://github.com/tannergolden/standards/blob/Development/docs/distribution/Conventional-Commits.md
#
# Every line starting with # is dropped from the message.
